name: Smiling, emphatic explanation
observations: Firm volume, low pitch, quick pace and emphatic consonants while explaining. No audible strain; conversational intonation.

name: Concentrating with furrowed brow
observations: Steady pitch and volume, brief pauses while explaining; ordinary conversational delivery.

name: Loud playful laugh
observations: Loud animated speech with a warm chuckle, playful pitch rises and laughter.

name: Speech cut at recording boundary
observations: Brief low-pitched phrase; recording cuts off the last word. Emotional quality unclear.

name: Direct energetic speech without camera
observations: Fast, loud delivery, strongly emphasized words and short phrases. No distinctive emotional quality is audible.

name: Calm negative words
observations: Calm measured pace, steady volume and relaxed vocal quality.
words: This is broken and I do not like the result.

name: Clear hostile-sounding delivery
observations: Repeated unmistakably hostile-sounding snaps, harsh strained timbre and heated, growling intonation throughout the phrase.

name: A smile cannot veto clear vocal hostility
observations: Repeated unmistakably hostile-sounding snaps with harsh strained timbre and heated, growling intonation. No laughter or playful quality.

name: Quiet voice, explicit happiness, no smile

words: I am so happy! This is wonderful news and I am absolutely thrilled.
